description:
Activate Rattleclaw Mystic's morph ability by paying {2}, turning it face-up.
Ratteclaw Mystic triggers twice, adding {G}{G}{U}{U}{R}{R}.
Activate Master of the Veil's morph ability by paying {2}{U}, turning it face-up.
Master of the Veil triggers twice, turning Rattleclaw Mystic and Master of the Veil face-down.
Repeat.
